4th Period.weeklyDeliverable: Due Sunday night: your live game link, your GameState plan, and 3 sentences about Singletons (85 points even if your game breaks), plus your live game showing GameState score and lives (15 points).
4th Period.workingNow: Open the Google Classroom assignment called Singleton Pattern. Read the instructions, follow them, then fill out the exit ticket when you are done.
4th Period.smartGoal: By the end of class, I can explain in my own words what a Singleton is and name one thing in MY game that could go in a GameState.

4th Period.eldStandard: ELD.PI.6-8.5 — Listening actively to spoken English in a range of social and academic contexts.
agenda: This week and the points (3 min)
I do: ask Copilot one question (5 min)
You do: ask Copilot about YOUR game (17 min)
Exit Ticket, then share out (15 min)
4th Period.connections: Last week you plugged a Component into your game. This whole week is about one idea, the Singleton. Today you just learn what it is by asking Copilot about your own game. Tomorrow you plan your GameState.

7th Period.weeklyDeliverable: Due Sunday night: a photo or short video of your tendon-string gripper picking up an object, turned in on Google Classroom.

7th Period.smartGoal: By the end of class, I can measure and cut my own cardboard pieces and build one finger that bends at 2 joints when I pull its string.
